Hi Liam —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments — received and uploaded to our vendor intake Drive folder. Short answers up-front:

- Yes, we do a micro-deposit for ACH verification. It will appear as "REDWOOD PAY" on the bank statement; amount is two small deposits that land within 48 hours.
- For remittance we recommend structured PO mapping: preferred pattern is "PO:<PO_NUM> | INV:<INVOICE_NUM>" in the payment reference. That lets our payOps auto-link receipts. If Orchard needs a different convention, we can add a secondary free-text field.

Next steps I can take here:
1) Send our vendor_onboarding_form (please complete and return).
2) Schedule micro-deposits after we receive completed form and bank letter (we have bank letter now).
3) Once micro-deposits verify, we'll flip the account to Active and confirm the first scheduled remittance.

I'm looping Priya (finops) to confirm the PO mapping rules and Marissa on the remittance timing.

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the upload and the partial form; that's perfect. Quick confirmations from FinOps:

- Micro-deposits: yes — two deposits, typically between $0.05 and $0.49, hit within 24-48 hours. Please confirm the exact account number digits (last 4) in the returned form so we can match.
- Wires: our wire flow accepts the same structured mapping in the remittance field. We log both fields (structured and free-text) in the payment record. For your first remittance, please include PO number(s) in the structured field; we will reconcile against invoices.
- Next milestone: once you confirm the two micro-deposit amounts, we'll mark the bank as verified and schedule the initial remittance window (we run vendor payments on the 1st and 15th).

If helpful, here's our preferred remittance examples: 
- Single PO = "PO:12345 | INV:2027-004"
- Multiple POs = "PO:12345,12346 | INV:2027-004"

I'll attach a short checklist to the Drive link and will ping when micro-deposits are triggered.

Attachments: (uploaded to Drive) vendor_payment_checklist.pdf
